jobs.description: The industrial-complex canonical load (root ADR-0040, ADR-0426; scripts/ops/industrial-complex-canonical-load.sh → publisher load-industrial-complex-canonical): the publisher reads the current rows of gold.complex_catalog_versions and inserts or updates catalog.industrial_complex by official complex code, keeping each row's id; nothing is deleted. Its own job since the catalog's takeover (root ADR-0564 §6, W103): it was a step of the lineage cycle after the Spark region-code merge, and the versions build now follows the code pairs on every build, so the load follows that build's `changed`. `changed` when a row was inserted or updated, otherwise `unchanged`.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet as its own job (W103); the same publisher command ran inside foundation-lineage-stewardship.service after the region-code merge with the catalog's 1,442 rows, under that unit's cap; sized as the edge export, which reads the same rows through the same reader (1G); systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: runs no DuckDB stage (load-industrial-complex-canonical reads the catalog through the snapshot reader and writes Postgres), so the stage's open check never reads it; 1G is its share of a task's disk on AWS beside its state_paths.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: one read of the catalog's current rows (1,442 complexes) and one upsert transaction of them into catalog.industrial_complex

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when a complex's current row changes: its source row, or the code pairs its region codes follow. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.

assets.description: 마이그레이션이 선언한 서빙 또는 운영 원장이다. 표 존재만으로 원천 적재 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.

dependencies.description: 판을 쌓는 표의 현재 행(계약의 규칙, 루트 ADR-0267)을 공식 단지 코드로 넣거나 고친다(루트 ADR-0040). 그 표의 빌드가 `changed` 를 알리면 돈다(루트 ADR-0564 §6).
